title: Quick Fix Vietnamese Cream Cheese Spring-Rolls
description: Quick-fix Vietnamese dish featuring cream cheese, agemono-deep-fry, gluten-free-friendly. Umami and juicy flavors in a flash.
instructions: Fill a large bowl with warm water. Dip each spring roll wrapper into the water for about 10 seconds, until it becomes soft and pliable.
Place a spring roll wrapper on a clean surface, with one corner pointing towards you.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of cream cheese in the center of the wrapper.
Add 2-3 pieces of shrimp, some chopped green onions, and a sprinkle of cilantro on top of the cream cheese.
Fold the bottom corner of the wrapper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrapper to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Heat about 1-2 inches of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F.
Fry the spring rolls in batches until they are golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per batch.
Drain the spring rolls on paper towels and serve hot with hoisin sauce, lime juice, and Vietnamese dipping sauce if desired.
Garnish with sliced fresh chilies and lime wedges if desired.
